Omelette went to Woof Gang on Front St for grooming for the first time, and we had such a great experience! As the owner of a very furry, double-coated dog, I’ve struggled to find groomers who really know how to properly care for her coat. We’ve tried several places over the years, including a groomer who is very well known for grooming Samoyeds, and our experience at Woof Gang was by far the best. Everyone was genuinely wonderful, and the level of care really stood out. At the end of the appointment, they even gave us a report card on Omelette’s condition and behaviour during the grooming and showed us photos and videos from her appointment, which I absolutely loved. A special thank you to Isabella, who groomed Omelette and did such an amazing job with her. You could really tell how much care and attention she put into the whole appointment.

Their prices are also very reasonable and most importantly, you can tell they genuinely love dogs and care about the animals they work with.

We’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommend Woof Gang on Front St even if you have a double-coated furry beast!

She was very understanding of our pup’s slightly nervous tendencies, and clearly communicated about the length and style of the groom she’d be doing. They trimmed her nails very quickly and gave her back to me with a beautiful pink bow on her neck. I was very happy with their service. I definitely recommend them!

Hi Amanda, I am sorry that we were unable to groom Loki and Bullet, but all dogs do need to be up to date on their rabies vaccinations for the safety of our groomers and the other dogs in the salon. Up to date rabies vaccinations are the law in Ontario and we must stay compliant with these rules. Once Loki is up to date we would love to welcome you back for a grooming service. Thank you
